theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_lhr_ds_weak_eq_fderiv
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (ω₁ ω₂ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (e : Rn n), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ω₁ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ω₂ U → (∀ φ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ U → ∫ x in U, ω₁ x (fderiv ℝ φ x) = ∫ x in U, ω₂ x (fderiv ℝ φ x)) → ∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → IntegrableOn (fun x => fderiv ℝ ω₁ x e (fderiv ℝ ζ x)) U ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x => fderiv ℝ ω₂ x e (fderiv ℝ ζ x)) U ∧ ∫ x in U, fderiv ℝ ω₁ x e (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = ∫ x in U, fderiv ℝ ω₂ x e (fderiv ℝ ζ x)
